not_measured: Pause, resume and cancel on a real PayPal subscription: each run would use up one of the owner's pre-approved sandbox subscriptions. Checked by hand on the live site instead (README, item 8 and 11 logs).
Approving a subscription on PayPal's own page: the robot never signs in to PayPal.
A screen reader and a real microphone: axe and keyboard checks are not a substitute.
